verdict.rationale: The only bulk-like evidence is that Authorization Rules can be applied at the program level, which covers the entire card program, or at the account level. That lets one configuration act on many cards at once. There is no evidence of batch or bulk API operations such as mass card creation, bulk updates or bulk state changes, and card creation is documented as single-item. Missing for 10: bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk card or account operations, MCP or agent-driven multi-item actions, and independent corroboration.
